description: This PHP source file defines an abstract Controller class implementing common HTTP response creation methods, JSON request parsing, and user extraction, used as a base for API controllers in the Reconmap project.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: An abstract base class for API controllers providing common functionalities such as JSON parsing, response creation, and user extraction.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger instance for the controller.

methods.name: getJsonBodyDecoded
methods.description: Decodes the JSON body of a request into an object.

methods.name: getJsonBodyDecodedAsClass
methods.description: Decodes JSON request body into a specified class instance.

methods.name: getJsonAsClass
methods.description: Maps JSON data to a class instance, optionally enforcing strict null types.

methods.name: getJsonBodyDecodedAsArray
methods.description: Decodes JSON request body into an associative array.

methods.name: createInternalServerErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates a 500 Internal Server Error response.

methods.name: createDeletedResponse
methods.description: Creates a 204 No Content response, alias for delete actions.

methods.name: createStatusCreatedResponse
methods.description: Creates a 201 Created response with JSON body.

methods.name: getUserFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts user information from request attributes.
